verdict.rationale: First-party docs show that mise declares per-project tool versions in a checked-in mise.toml. It also reads .tool-versions and idiomatic version files, merges hierarchical config, and switches versions automatically on directory change. Installs are reproducible via committed lockfiles and `mise install`. Independent community reports corroborate unifying team toolchains (node, python, rust, go) from one config file and replacing nvm, rvm and pyenv.
